name: smart-bangladesh-weather-agriculture
description: আবহাওয়া বন্ধু — Smart Bangladesh Weather & Agriculture Platform

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'dev', '--prefix', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
